name: fiscai-yuki-api-connector
description: Plugin for Grok Bot (also works with Copilot, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf and other MCP clients): read-only access to the Yuki accounting API for Belgian accountants and business owners. Powered by FISCALCI Accounting & Tax (Askin Alci)

yuki_access_key.title: Yuki access key
yuki_access_key.description: Your Yuki WebserviceAccessKey (portal or domain key). Stored in secure storage, never in files.

yuki_access_level.title: Access level
yuki_access_level.description: portaal (accountant portal key, all administrations) or domein (key per domain).

yuki_daily_limit.title: Daily call limit
yuki_daily_limit.description: Maximum Yuki calls per domain per day (default 900; Yuki: 1000 per domain per day are free).
